Corollary
[conjugate heat inequality for reduced density] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 3.2.6\group Cao–Zhu Comparison Theorems for Perelman’s Reduced Volume Let $g_{ij}(\tau )$, $\tau \geq 0$, be a family of metrics evolving by the Ricci flow $\frac{\partial }{\partial \tau }g_{ij}=2R_{ij}$ on a compact $n$-dimensional manifold $M$. Fix a point $p$ in $M$ and let $l(q,\tau )$ be the Li-Yau-Perelman distance from $(p,0)$. Then for all $\tau $, \[ \min \{ l(q,\tau )\ |\ \ q\in M\} \leq \frac{n}{2}. \]

Proof

\sketch For $\bar L=4\tau l$, combine the identities for $l$ to get $(\partial _\tau +\Delta )\bar L\le 2n$ and apply the maximum principle.

□
